name: Native binding signature preservation requires a bound native fixture

input.fixture_ref: Bind a native Method with declared primitive and handle parameters, then cross valid and invalid arguments and returns through its recorded Contract.

applicability.reason: Requires a BOUND native fixture. The FFI surface exists further than an unbound-symbol refusal suggests: FFI.open answers an FFI::Library, lib.bind reaches IncompleteNativeSignatureError and lib.call reaches UnboundNativeSymbolError. Every path still ends at a refusal, so no recorded Contract exists to cross valid and invalid arguments and returns against, which is the observation this row makes.

expect.status: Metadata callable signature is preserved and every written Contract remains a static and runtime boundary guard.
